title: A current vanishing on test forms supported off a closed set K has support in K
statement: Let P, q ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ ℝ^P closed, and Z ∈ D_q(V) (GeometricCurrentOn V q) with Z(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ D^q(V) whose tsupport is disjoint from K. Then spt Z ⊆ K. Here spt Z = Z.support = V ∖ zeroRegion(Z), and zeroRegion(Z) is the union of all open W ⊆ ℝ^P with closure W compact, closure W ⊆ V and Z(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ D^q(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W (Simon Ch. 6, 2.11).
lean_statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (V K : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn V q), IsOpen V → IsClosed K → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V q, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q)) K → Z ω = 0) → Z.support ⊆ K
